verdicts.evidence: The DRAFT branch's catch now answers 'excluded': an unreadable DRAFT disappears from the total while staying in the to-ratify list (unratifiedAdrs, not mutated, pushes it through its own catch). Measured recipe: mission init + ADR-0007 accepted + DRAFT-ADR-0016-locked.md at chmod 000; `check --coverage` shipped: 'Decisions 1/2 ratified (1 to ratify)' + the DRAFT listed; mutated: 'Decisions 0/1 ratified (1 to ratify)' + the SAME DRAFT listed — total cut short, ratified crushed to 0 by the Math.max clamp, a self-contradicting display (1 file to ratify outside a total that no longer contains it). Why nothing sees it: no fixture in the legs places an unreadable file in adr/; smoke replayed on the mutated build: green.
